sam-support: FYI — customer says welcome/free-trial credits never arrived after signup. they completed email verification + phone OTP and 3DS succeeded. signed up from Italy with a virtual card. customer expects 2000 trial tokens. any ideas? :thinking:
erin-support: can you drop account id + signup time + pm last4 so i can check audit logs? :eyes:
sam-support: account: acct_01G7XYZ, email: luca@uniroma.it, signup 2025-09-10T14:12:33Z. payment method last4 4242, bin country US (virtual). 3DS: success. user verified email and phone. no promo code applied. they reported immediately after signup.
payments-bot: automated-check: region=EU-IT, email_domain=uniroma.it (edu), pm_bin_country=US, 3DS=passed, fraud_flag=CROSSBORDER_BIN, manual_review=true, promo_eligible=false. pm_id=pm_1I2abc. internal link: https://internal/payments/pm_1I2abc
jordan-ops: sounds like the crossborder bin rule fired. we have a rule that flags EDU domains + cross-border PMs for manual review. that will block auto-grants until payments ops clears.
erin-support: audit shows hold applied by rule "crossborder_bin_edu" at 2025-09-10T14:12:35Z. also noticed the welcome-grant webhook ran but resulted in 'skipped: promo_eligible=false' in grants log.
sam-support: i tried re-triggering the grant job using the internal admin endpoint: `POST /internal/grants?account=acct_01G7XYZ` returned 200 but balance unchanged. logs: `grant skipped: promo_eligible=false`.
jordan-ops: ok — we'll need a manual override from payments. sam, can you open ops ticket with logs and ask for manual grant + flip promo_eligible? include 3DS evidence.
sam-support: opened payment ops ticket SUP-14286, pinged payments team. ticket link: https://internal/ops/SUP-14286 :point_up:
payments-bot: ops ticket created SUP-14286 assigned to @payments-ops. ETA ~2h. automated-checklist attached.
erin-support: when payments grants, please include txn id and amount so I can reconcile and close with customer. also paste the exact curl payload you used for the grant so audit is clear.
jordan-ops: suggested manual payload below for payments team to run in admin tool:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.admin/grants \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"account_id":"acct_01G7XYZ","credits":2000,"reason":"manual override: verified email + 3DS passed; edu domain; crossborder bin flagged"}'
```
Please add ticket id SUP-14286 in metadata.

erin-support: also add a follow-up action to adjust rule "crossborder_bin_edu" to not block auto-grants when 3DS==passed AND email_domain_type==edu. filing infra/ops task after this incident.
payments-bot: update at 1755557000: manual grant applied by @maria-payments txn=txn_9Kabc123 credits=2000. balance updated. link: https://internal/payments/txn_txn_9Kabc123
sam-support: confirmed with customer — credits now visible. customer happy, closing from our side. :tada:
jordan-ops: leaving a follow-up in infra backlog to tune crossborder rule. assigning infra ticket INFRA-4582.
erin-support: thanks everyone. documented in SUP-14286 and added notes to account audit. resolving thread.
